title: The Last Letter
author: Silas Okafor
blurb: Ines Iversen, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
